final: WITH event_counts AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event), total AS (SELECT SUM(attendance_count) AS attendance_total FROM event_counts) SELECT event_id, attendance_count, 1.0 * attendance_count / attendance_total AS share FROM event_counts CROSS JOIN total WHERE attendance_total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
